mapper.select:
SELECT inquiry_id, title, content, category, created_at, updated_at, views, member_id, writer FROM inquiry
1=1
AND title Like CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%')
ORDER BY inquiry_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiry (title, content, category, writer) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{writer})
mapper.update: UPDATE inquiry SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, writer = #{writer} WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}
